senses.gloss:
गभस्ति गभस्ति, m. and f.
 1. An arm, Chr. 290, 10 = Rigv. i. 64, 10.
 2. A ray of light, Rām. 4, 27, 3.

गभस्तिमन्त् गभस्ति + मन्त्,
 I. adj., f. मती, Radiant, MBh. 2, 443.
 II. m. The sun, Ragh. 3, 37.

गभीर गभीर (from a lost vb. गभ्, A.S. geapan) and गम्भीर गम्भीर,
 I. adj., f. रा,
 1. Deep, Rām. 1, 5, 10; dwelling in the depth, Pañc. v. d. 10.
 2. Thick, impervious, Rām. 3, 53, 22.
 3. Deep-toned, Rām. 3, 30, 27.
 4. Unfathomable, Bhāg. P. 9, 14, 14.
 II. m. गभीर, A proper name, Bhāg. P. 9, 17, 10.
 III. f. गम्भीरा, The name of a river, Megh. 41.
 --Cf. βαϕ in βάπτω and गहन.
